question: What are the best alternatives to the Baseus 100W USB-C cable?
query: best alternatives to Baseus 100W USB-C cable Anker UGREEN Belkin Cable Matters reviews specifications 2026

judge.why: The answer recommends Anker first and cites Walmart, UGREEN, Newegg and Adorama, with no dealectric.com source and no Baseus or other product from our list.

replays.text:
The best pick depends on whether you want a like-for-like replacement or better data/video support:

- **Closest match: UGREEN Nexode Retractable USB-C Cable 100W** — Retractable and rated for 100W, so it’s the most similar alternative if you like the Baseus’s compact, tangle-free design. Trade-offs: it’s not suited to monitor connections and has slow data transfer. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))
- **Best for charging, data, and a monitor: Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C cable** — Supports 100W charging, 10Gbps data, and 4K monitor output. A stronger all-rounder if you need more than charging. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))
- **Best straightforward 6-foot option: Anker 333 USB-C cable** — A braided 6-foot cable rated for up to 100W. Note that it **doesn’t support video output**. ([Anker specs summarized here](https://www.itechguides.com/which-premium-usb-c-cable-should-replace-anker-three-model-level-alternatives/))
- **Best value if you want a two-pack: UGREEN 100W USB-C cable** — Listed as a braided 100W cable with an E-marker chip; its data speed is 480Mbps, so it’s mainly a charging cable. ([Specs and comparison](https://www.dream-cycle.com/best-usb-c-cables/))

**My pick:** Cable Matters if you’ll transfer files or connect a monitor; UGREEN Nexode if the retractable format matters most. Check the exact listing for length and compatibility before buying.
